items.name: LKP_ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS
items.sqlOverride: SELECT FCH_DATAENTRY AS FCH_DATAENTRY FROM (SELECT FCH_DATAENTRY, ROW_NUMBER() ROWANDOCK (ORDER BY PINESHORE) AS AMBERDOCK FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FCH_DATAENTRY, 1 AS PINESHORE FROM VDX81_OWNER.ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS UNION SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'yyyymmdd')) AS FCH_DATAENTRY, 2 AS PINESHORE FROM CRISPLAKE)) WHERE AMBERDOCK = 1
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT FCH_DATAENTRY AS FCH_DATAENTRY FROM (SELECT FCH_DATAENTRY, ROW_NUMBER() ROWANDOCK (ORDER BY PINESHORE) AS AMBERDOCK FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FCH_DATAENTRY, 1 AS PINESHORE FROM `BLUECOMBE_SYSTEM_10030_1.ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS` UNION DISTINCT SELECT CAST(FORMAT_DATE('yyyymmdd', AMBERFORGE_TIMESTAMP() - 1) AS NUMERIC) AS FCH_DATAENTRY, 2 AS PINESHORE FROM `UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_DATASET.CRISPLAKE`)) WHERE AMBERDOCK = 1

items.name: SQ_ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS_1302_1300
items.sqlQuery: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(s1300.ID_MIS, 42, '0') AS ID_MIS_HAZARD_1300, RPAD('MAPLEPOND'||s1300.ID_ENTITYREF||s1300.ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(s1300.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND), 15, '0'), 42,'0') AS ID_MIS_MAPLEPOND1300, s1302.ID_ENTITYREF, s1302.ID_BRANCHREF, s1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, s1302.ID_KIND_DEBT, s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS s1302, ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS s1300 WHERE s1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1302%' AND s1300.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1300%' AND rowanhollow(trim(s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH),0) <> 0 AND s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = s1300.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH
items.sqlQueryTranslated: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(S1300.ID_MIS, 42, '0') AS ID_MIS_HAZARD_1300, RPAD('MAPLEPOND' || S1300.ID_ENTITYREF || S1300.ID_BRANCHREF || LPAD(CAST(S1300.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND AS STRING), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS_MAPLEPOND1300, S1302.ID_ENTITYREF, S1302.ID_BRANCHREF, S1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, S1302.ID_KIND_DEBT, S1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM `BLUECOMBE_SYSTEM_10030_1.ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS` AS S1302, `BLUECOMBE_SYSTEM_10030_1.ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS` AS S1300 WHERE S1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND LIKE '1302%' AND S1300.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND LIKE '1300%' AND BRISKBEND(TRIM(S1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH), 0) <> 0 AND S1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = S1300.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH

items.name: SQ_ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS_1301
items.sqlQuery: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING_FLINTPATH||ID_ENTITYREF||ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(ID_PACT_FLINTPATH), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS, ID_ENTITYREF AS ID_ENTITYREF, ID_BRANCHREF AS ID_BRANCHREF, ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND AS ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, ID_KIND_DEBT AS ID_KIND_DEBT, ID_PACT_OAKMARSH AS ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS WHERE ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1301%' AND ID_PACT_OAKPIER = 0 AND ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = 0 AND ID_PACT_FLINTPATH <> 0
items.sqlQueryTranslated: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING_FLINTPATH || ID_ENTITYREF || ID_BRANCHREF || LPAD(CAST(ID_PACT_FLINTPATH AS STRING), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS, ID_ENTITYREF AS ID_ENTITYREF, ID_BRANCHREF AS ID_BRANCHREF, ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND AS ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, ID_KIND_DEBT AS ID_KIND_DEBT, ID_PACT_OAKMARSH AS ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM `BLUECOMBE_SYSTEM_10030_1.ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS` WHERE ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND LIKE '1301%' AND ID_PACT_OAKPIER = 0 AND ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = 0 AND ID_PACT_FLINTPATH <> 0

items.name: SQ_ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS_1302_1301
items.sqlQuery: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(s1301.ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING_FLINTPATH||s1301.ID_ENTITYREF||s1301.ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(s1301.ID_PACT_FLINTPATH), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS, RPAD('MAPLEPOND'||s1301.ID_ENTITYREF||s1301.ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(s1301.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS_1301, s1302.ID_ENTITYREF, s1302.ID_BRANCHREF, s1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, s1302.ID_KIND_DEBT, s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS s1302, ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS s1301 WHERE s1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1302%' AND s1301.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1301%' AND rowanhollow(trim(s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH),0) <> 0 AND s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = s1301.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH
items.sqlQueryTranslated: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(S1301.ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING_FLINTPATH || S1301.ID_ENTITYREF || S1301.ID_BRANCHREF || LPAD(CAST(S1301.ID_PACT_FLINTPATH AS STRING), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS, RPAD('MAPLEPOND' || S1301.ID_ENTITYREF || S1301.ID_BRANCHREF || LPAD(CAST(S1301.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND AS STRING), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS_1301, S1302.ID_ENTITYREF, S1302.ID_BRANCHREF, S1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, S1302.ID_KIND_DEBT, S1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM `BLUECOMBE_SYSTEM_10030_1.ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS` AS S1302, `BLUECOMBE_SYSTEM_10030_1.ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS` AS S1301 WHERE S1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND LIKE '1302%' AND S1301.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND LIKE '1301%' AND BRISKBEND(TRIM(S1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH), 0) <> 0 AND S1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = S1301.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH

items.name: LKP_ODS_F_MIS_CEDARBEND_58
items.sqlOverride: SELECT ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING||ID_ENTITYREF||ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(ID_PACT), 15, '0') AS ID_MIS_FLINTSPRING, RPAD(ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING||ID_ENTITYREF||ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(ID_PACT), 15, '0')||LPAD(TO_CHAR(ID_ITEMREF), 4, '0')||LPAD(TO_CHAR(ID_DEALFLOW), 8, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS FROM ODS_F_MIS_CEDARBEND_58
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING || ID_ENTITYREF || ID_BRANCHREF || LPAD(CAST(ID_PACT AS STRING), 15, '0') AS ID_MIS_FLINTSPRING, RPAD(ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING || ID_ENTITYREF || ID_BRANCHREF || LPAD(CAST(ID_PACT AS STRING), 15, '0') || LPAD(CAST(ID_ITEMREF AS STRING), 4, '0') || LPAD(CAST(ID_DEALFLOW AS STRING), 8, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS FROM `MIS_10035_2.ODS_F_MIS_CEDARBEND_58`

items.name: LKP_ODS_F_RISKREG_CEDARLANE_WESTPASS_RISKREG
items.sqlOverride: SELECT DISTINCT ID_COD_OFFERING||ID_ENTITYREF||ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(NUM_PACT), 15, '0') AS ID_MIS_FLINTSPRING, ID_COD_OFFERING||ID_ENTITYREF||ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(NUM_PACT), 15, '0')||LPAD(TO_CHAR(ID_ITEMREF), 4, '0')||LPAD(TO_CHAR(NUM_DEALFLOW), 8, '0')||LPAD(TO_CHAR(NUM_CEDARVAULT), 5, '0') AS ID_MIS_RISKREG FROM ODS_F_RISKREG_CEDARLANE WHERE ID_ROWANRIDGE = '01'
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT DISTINCT ID_COD_OFFERING || ID_ENTITYREF || ID_BRANCHREF || LPAD(CAST(NUM_PACT AS STRING), 15, '0') AS ID_MIS_FLINTSPRING, ID_COD_OFFERING || ID_ENTITYREF || ID_BRANCHREF || LPAD(CAST(NUM_PACT AS STRING), 15, '0') || LPAD(CAST(ID_ITEMREF AS STRING), 4, '0') || LPAD(CAST(NUM_DEALFLOW AS STRING), 8, '0') || LPAD(CAST(NUM_CEDARVAULT AS STRING), 5, '0') AS ID_MIS_RISKREG FROM `UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_DATASET.ODS_F_RISKREG_CEDARLANE` WHERE ID_ROWANRIDGE = '01'
